original_analysis: An unexecuted same-baseline comparison keeps d/2 fixed and changes M to M2. More allowed memory is not proof of sufficient memory; denser retained samples are not proof of acceptable character output.
scope: Single-level, non-World-Partition discussion chosen for this explanation, not a documented compatibility conclusion.
Project must already use the documented VLM precomputed path and settings.
Low density does not uniquely diagnose memory pressure; nearly uniform lighting is a documented alternative.
GPU per-pixel and mobile CPU bounds-center evaluation are distinguished.
No exact eightfold total-memory prediction, measured performance or universal leakage fix.
